The PR exists to eliminate the #3965 operator-facing lie where the body rendered `Status: passed` while state recorded `failed`.

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14775-14797 (successor-adoption arm of the security-pass-fixing watcher: jq write of .security_pass_active_fix_issues = [$successor] at 14777-14779, post_state_comment at 14786, tracking comment at 14787-14789, continue at 14797) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: this security-pass state transition mutates a field the tracking body renders and posts its state comment without calling reconcile_tracking_body_after_security_pass_transition, unlike the seven transitions this PR wires up. This PR's blocked-write reconcile now renders "- Active fix issue: #N" into the body (asserted by the new test test_security_pass_blocked_transition_rerenders_tracking_body_security_block). When orchestrator stall recovery later closes fix issue #N and re-issues it as #M, the successor arm adopts #M into state, posts state + tracking + completion-status comments, and continues. On every subsequent tick the "remains in progress" branch (14802-14805) also continues with no reconcile, and the tick-level reconcile sites (merge_conflict / wave-status paths) are never reached while the project sits in security-pass-fixing. The body therefore keeps advertising the closed predecessor #N as the active fix issue with Status: blocked for the successor's entire clarify → plan → implement → review cycle (potentially days) — exactly the operator-facing stale-body defect (label and alert comment correct, body wrong) that #3965 exhibited and that this PR's title and description commit to eliminating ("keep the tracking body honest on every security-pass transition").
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: the rendered <!-- orchestrator:security-pass --> block diverges from .security_pass_active_fix_issues the moment the successor jq write lands, and no code path re-renders it until the successor merges and the pass re-runs. The one-line fix mirrors every sibling transition: insert reconcile_tracking_body_after_security_pass_transition immediately before post_state_comment || true at 14786 (the merged-fix arm at 14748-14757 does not need it because it falls through to the same-tick security-pass arm at 14809 whose return transitions all reconcile; the successor arm continues instead, so it does not self-heal).
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
